claims.assertion: Yazhi’s model treats existence as ideas in a timeless, nonlocal Source-mind; minerals and energy are conscious.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says simple consciousnesses combine into complex beings, from cells and bodies to individual universes and the Source.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says idea-attachments define identity and filter the world each person experiences.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: After death, attachments shape one’s world: some realms mirror material life, others are peaceful.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says perceptual realms overlap through shared agreements, allowing spirits and other entities to interact with embodied beings.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
